purpose: Canonical internal register of distinct professional-continuity, independence, fee/payment, withdrawal and handover incidents involving project-side lawyers and firms. An incident record is not a finding of wrongdoing.

4-Jan-2019 correspondence says Armando, Luis and Joaquín were designing strategy.
21-Jan-2019 BBC communication was subject to Luis review/validation and Luis approved it.

next_expansion_rule: Every newly alleged or discovered lawyer/firm interference, payment, payment assurance, Bar/disciplinary threat, withdrawal, venia, handover, file-custody, retainer, fee-control or third-party-contact episode receives its own PD-PII incident_id before being relied upon in cross-lawyer pattern analysis.
